name: DBS SAFRA Card

percent:local.note: On local Mastercard contactless transactions with minimum spend of S$500. Earned in the form of SAFRA$. Capped at SAFRA$50 per calendar month.

highlights: Earn up to 3% cashback in the form of SAFRA$ on local Mastercard contactless transactions, online shopping, and public transport (bus/train via SimplyGo) with a minimum monthly spend of S$500. Cashback is capped at SAFRA$50 per month. For all other transactions, earn 0.30% cashback, also capped at SAFRA$50 per month.
pros: Enjoy up to 3% cash rebate on local contactless spend and online shopping, including bus/train rides via SimplyGo.
pros: Earn 1 SAFRAPOINT for every dollar spent at participating outlets and facilities at SAFRA.
pros: Doubles as your SAFRA Membership Card.
pros: Enjoy exclusive access to 7 SAFRA Clubhouse islandwide.
pros: Combined DBS and SAFRA privileges that include exclusive discounts and perks at over 1,800 merchant outlets.
pros: No annual fee charged as long as you remain a SAFRA memeber. SAFRA membership fees still applies..
cons: Applicant must be an existing SAFRA member.
cons: Must spend a min. of S$500 in a calendar month to earn 3% cash rebate.
cons: Cash rebates earned will be in the form of SAFRA$ and is capped at SAFRA$50 per card account per calendar month.
cons: SAFRA$ earn will expire 12 calendar months from the date it was earned. All expired SAFRA$ will be forfeited.

extra.description: The DBS SAFRA Card grants you access to SAFRA clubhouse facilities around Singapore. You'll also enjoy exclusive benefits at over 1,800 merchants and up to 3% cash rebate on contactless spend and online shopping.
